lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately six visible vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are arranged in a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank, with horizontal spacing between columns appearing relatively uniform.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint, pale vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, forming distinct nodes at the spot centroids throughout the mid-section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single dominant horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal edge and a deep shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Small, discrete high-luminance spots are irregularly distributed across the visible lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, appearing with lower density than on the primary lateral flank.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, elongated remora is attached to the ventral-lateral surface of the mid-body, positioned directly beneath the primary spot grid.
